feeds.title: BECOMING JEWISH Blog
feeds.description: With over 30 years of experience in Jewish education, Rabbi Samuel provides a wealth of knowledge and resources to guide readers through the conversion journey. From exploring the basics of Jewish belief to navigating the complexities of halakha, BECOMING JEWISH Blog is an excellent source of information for those interested in converting to Judaism.

feeds.title: Ritualwell » Conversion
feeds.description: Ritualwell is an online community that provides resources and support for Jewish rituals and spirituality. Their Conversion section offers a range of articles and resources related to Jewish conversion, including personal stories, ritual guides, and prayers.

feeds.title: Orthodox Conversion Blog
feeds.description: Orthodox Conversion Blog is a personal blog by Rabbi Jack Abramowitz, who shares his insights and perspectives on Orthodox Jewish conversion. From discussing the intricacies of halakhic conversion to reflecting on the emotional and spiritual aspects of the process, Rabbi Abramowitz offers a unique and insightful perspective on the Orthodox conversion journey.

feeds.title: Newish Jewish Blog » Conversion
feeds.description: Newish Jewish is a blog focused on the experience of conversion to Judaism. Whether you are new to Judaism or have been Jewish for a while, this blog offers a wealth of information and resources to help guide you through the conversion process. Newish Jewish is a valuable resource for anyone considering or going through conversion.

feeds.title: Study Judaism Blog
feeds.description: Converting to Judaism Blog is an informative platform that provides guidance and support to those interested in converting to Judaism. With a focus on the practical aspects of conversion, this blog offers articles on Jewish customs and practices, conversion requirements, and the conversion process itself.

feeds.title: The Times of Israel Blog » Conversion to Judaism
feeds.description: Founded in 2012, this blog covers various aspects of Jewish conversion, including personal experiences, challenges, and reflections. Whether you're exploring Judaism for the first time or seeking guidance on your conversion journey, The Times of Israel Blog is a valuable resource to learn from a diverse range of voices.

feeds.title: Anna Rajagopal Blog
feeds.description: Anna Rajagopal is a conversion coach and mentor who provides guidance and support to those interested in converting to Judaism. With a focus on the spiritual and emotional aspects of the conversion process, Anna's blog offers insights and reflections on the challenges and rewards of converting to Judaism.
